annotations.text:
Assumptions
· Existing tri-colour mark kept; wordmark set in Geist.
· One accent: signal orange #E8541C for fills, orange ink #B4400E for text (AA).
· Navy panels = instruments only (devices, diagrams, specs, dashboards).
· [CLIENT] tags and the 'Fielded with' names are placeholders until logo permissions and case-study numbers are confirmed.
· Dashboard panels are layout placeholders for real screenshots.

Product template: the current Challenge → How we help → Specs → Use cases arc is kept; a plain-language outcome layer (hero, who it's for, what you get) sits above it. Same template serves every hardware product.
